extName.description: Extension name shown in the toolbar, side panel title, and heading.

extDescription.description: Extension description shown in the browser's extension management page.

promptApiAvailable.message: Prompt API is available in this browser.
promptApiAvailable.description: Shown in the side panel when LanguageModel exists.

promptApiUnavailable.message: Prompt API is not available in this browser.
promptApiUnavailable.description: Shown in the side panel when LanguageModel is missing.

modelUnavailable.message: The built-in model is not available on this device.
modelUnavailable.description: Error when the built-in Prompt API model cannot be used.

promptApiSetupHint.message: Check whether Prompt API is available and complete setup on this page.
promptApiSetupHint.description: Shown when Prompt API cannot be used. Followed by a link to the setup page.

promptApiSetupAction.message: Open the Prompt API setup page
promptApiSetupAction.description: Link label for https://kaibadash.github.io/prompt-api-example/, where the user checks and configures Prompt API.

modelPreparing.description: Shown while the side panel checks whether the built-in model is ready.

modelDownloading.description: Shown while the built-in model is downloading. PROGRESS is an integer from 0 to 100.

modelDownloadNeeded.message: Download the built-in model to start chatting.
modelDownloadNeeded.description: Shown when the built-in model is not downloaded yet.

modelDownloadAction.description: Button that starts downloading the built-in model. The click is required because the browser only allows the download from a user action.

chatEmpty.message: Send a message to start the conversation.
chatEmpty.description: Shown in the side panel before the first message.

chatPending.description: Shown while waiting for the assistant's first token.

chatInputLabel.description: Accessible name for the chat text field.

chatPlaceholder.description: Placeholder text in the chat text field.

chatSend.description: Button that sends the chat message.

chatClear.description: Button that removes the messages in the side panel.

chatStop.description: Button that stops the assistant response.

chatRoleUser.description: Label for a message sent by the user.

chatRoleAssistant.description: Label for a message sent by the assistant.

toolGetBrowserState.description: Shown while the agent reads interactive elements on the active page.

toolClickElement.description: Shown while the agent clicks an element on the active page.

toolInputText.description: Shown while the agent types into an element on the active page.

toolSelectOption.description: Shown while the agent selects an option on the active page.

toolScroll.description: Shown while the agent scrolls the active page.

openOptions.description: Button in the side panel that opens the extension settings page.

optionsTitle.description: Heading of the extension settings page.

optionsLanguageLabel.description: Label for the Prompt API language selector.

optionsLanguageHint.message: The built-in model uses this language for input and output. If you have not chosen one, it follows your browser language.
optionsLanguageHint.description: Explains the model language setting and that the default follows the browser language.

optionsInstructionsLabel.description: Label for the text field where the user sets instructions included in every conversation.

optionsInstructionsHint.message: These instructions are included in every conversation. Leave this empty to use only the built-in instructions.
optionsInstructionsHint.description: Explains the default instructions field on the settings page.
